children: Sept 11 (Reuters)- The ratio of Canadian household debt-to-income widens to 175.1% in the second quarter from a downwardly revised 174.8% in the first quarter, Statistics Canada said on Friday.   National net worth edged up by 1.0% in the second quarter to C$17.92 trillion ($12.93 trillion), while national net worth increased to C$490,193 on a per capita basis.  ($1=$1.3860 Canadian)
(Reporting by Dale Smith; Editing by Maria Cheng) ((maria.cheng@tr.com))
